::: info COUNTERS-ARE-FLAGGED
**A counter two people change at once is flagged, not added up**

qty = qty + 1 on two copies at once is not summed when they merge: the runtime keeps both numbers, shows one, and marks the row pending until someone writes it again. For something several people add to, insert a row per addition and count the rows.

**Why.** A change travels as the value it left, not the arithmetic: qty = qty + 1 and qty = 6 are the same change. Summing would guess at intent, and a wrong guess is a silent loss; a flag is not.

<small>Applies to every shape · refused at run time · [COUNTERS-ARE-FLAGGED in Constraints](/docs/constraints#COUNTERS-ARE-FLAGGED)</small>
:::
